PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_2 A4 And A7 Phase Gates And Pre-Commit
PHASE.GOAL: Implement autonomous phase progression and enforce pre-commit verification before bounded run completion.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Active phase from plan-index.xml flows through status and gate policy evaluation into dry-run or safe phase advance.
Final run step flows through pre-commit verification before completion can set RunOutcomeKind::Success.

STEPS.step-1: Implement check_phase_gates, advance_phase, dry-run behavior, and action queue integration.
STEPS.step-2: Implement pre_commit_verify and structured gate failure metadata.
STEPS.step-3: Inject PreCommitVerify before final CompleteStep and block completion on failed gates.
STEPS.step-4: Expose advance_phase and pre_commit_check MCP handlers.

RISKS.RISK: Phase XML updates must be atomic enough to avoid plan-index corruption on failure.
Pre-commit verification must not permanently strand runs that self-heal can fix.
